readerCopy.headline: Wanting more space and more closeness can happen at the same time.
readerCopy.body:
One person may want more time together while the other needs more room. You may want the relationship and not the schedule it currently requires. A purchase or shared plan can also expose different ideas about what is worth spending on. Both desires can be sincere and still pull in different directions.

Jupiter opposing Venus makes desire larger on both sides. Say the actual need before generosity turns into overgiving or distance gets interpreted as rejection. The connection may not need less affection. It may need terms that fit both people's lives.
doNotAssume: Do not assume romance, breakup, financial conflict, infidelity, or that one person's desire is excessive.
